spec.query:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  severity_text,
  coalesce(nullif(json_get_string(log_attributes, '_SYSTEMD_UNIT'), ''), json_get_string(resource_attributes, '$."service.name"')) AS source,
  json_get_string(log_attributes, 'SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER') AS ident,
  json_get_string(log_attributes, '_PID') AS pid,
  body
FROM opentelemetry_logs
WHERE coalesce(nullif(json_get_string(log_attributes, '_SYSTEMD_UNIT'), ''), json_get_string(resource_attributes, '$."service.name"')) = 'user@1000.service'
  AND timestamp BETWEEN to_timestamp_millis($__from) AND to_timestamp_millis($__to)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1000
